Screw in spaghetti. It’s your fault, not our fault.
Dec 2025 • Family
I found a screw in my cream spaghetti. I called the waitress, she took in the kitchen and brought out the same plate of spaghetti. We were totally shocked, I ask the waitress why. She said the screw is from the pepper grinder, they didn’t put in the spaghetti, we are the one that put it in, so it is our fault! We were speechless! We asked for her manager. Her manager said it is not their fault, it is our fault!!!!! I told him that his waitress also used pepper grinder to helped us to put the pepper. He even wanted to see the CCTV to prove to us that we dropped the screw in. We were really angry and disgusted. I wanted to vomit out all the food. I told him even if we dropped the screw in, the pepper grinder is from you, don’t you think that you should make sure that the screw is tightened properly so that it won’t dropped out easily? He said it was on our table, we should be in charge of that! He expects us to check the everything before we used it! In the end, the manager changed a new plate of spaghetti for us. I didn’t eat anything and my last meal was 9am. We were there at 8pm. I felt like digging all my food out as there are many bacteria on the screw. Utterly disgusting. The service level is really very very very very very very bad, ridiculous, terrible.
The food has no taste that is why we need to add salt and pepper.
I will never ever step into his place. Very bad service. Lost of words. 
When we left, the manager gave us 10% discount. I told him I don’t want the discount. He happily changed the bill and removed the 10%. I told him he is not sincere and not apologetic. He should have insisted on the 10% discount. He just smiled. Really disgusted. When I told my friends about this incident, everyone was shocked and they said this is the worst ever experience that they heard of.
